meta.title: Bazaar — a system for the modern store
meta.description: POS, products, stock, customers, analytics and connected sales channels in one Bazaar system.
meta.socialTitle: Bazaar — your entire store in one system
meta.structuredDescription: A retail system for POS, products, inventory, customers, analytics and integrations.

hero.kicker: A system for the modern store
hero.title: Your entire store. In one system.
hero.lead: Sales, products, stock, customers and analytics are connected in one system. Add online stores and sales channels as your business grows.
hero.note: No installation · Works in your browser · Mobile/PWA
hero.desktopAlt: The actual Bazaar desktop POS with a product catalog and current receipt
hero.mobileAlt: The actual Bazaar mobile POS interface

platform.body: A sale updates stock, and analytics shows the result. Once channels are connected, Bazaar integrations exchange products, prices and orders.

cashier.label: POS
cashier.title: A sale without extra screens
cashier.body: The catalog, current receipt, discount, customer and payment share one workspace.

inventory.label: Inventory
inventory.title: Stock with a clear history
inventory.body: Every change is tied to a sale, delivery, transfer, write-off or stock count.

products.label: Products
products.title: A catalog for your sales channels
products.body: Prices, variants, barcodes, photos and availability by store are managed centrally.

customers.label: Customers
customers.title: Keep the customer in the picture
customers.body: Contacts, orders and email eligibility are collected in one customer database.

commerce.label: Sales channels
commerce.title: One source of data for your channels
commerce.body: Configure Bazaar API and marketplaces to exchange products, prices, stock and orders within each channel's capabilities.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.title: Numbers tied to operations
analytics.body: Sales, costs, margins and inventory are calculated from actual business movements.

pos.title: Sell in seconds
pos.description: Bazaar POS brings search, the current receipt, customer and payment together for a fast, accurate sale.

inventory.title: Every product under control
inventory.description: Receipts, transfers, write-offs and counts create a transparent movement history for each store and variant.

analytics.title: See the numbers. Understand the business.
analytics.description: Bazaar connects sales, inventory value and costs so the numbers answer an owner's everyday questions.
analytics.alt: Bazaar business dashboard with sales and margins

commerce.body: Bazaar API, marketplaces and customer communications work around a shared catalog. Data exchange availability and schedules depend on integration settings.
commerce.label: Example data exchange through Bazaar integrations
commerce.title: One Bazaar catalog
commerce.subtitle: One source of data for channels you connect

mobile.title: Bazaar goes with you
mobile.body: Sales, the catalog and working operations adapt to phones and tablets. Mobile workflows account for smaller screens and touch controls.

proof.title: Verified customer experience.
proof.body: Only verified case studies, logos and results will appear here, with customer permission. Until then, Bazaar does not publish invented reviews or statistics.

final.tag: A system for your store · Bazaar
final.line2: Bring its work together in one system.

footer.description: A system for the modern store.
